t: Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the building referred to in section 1 shall be deemed to be a reference to the “James W. McCabe, Sr. Post Office Building”.

fable.w: This section only provides that references in federal records to a building are deemed references to its new name, a post office naming provision. The word "regulation" appears only in a list of record types and does not authorize rulemaking or involve any outside party in a federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a purely administrative renaming provision. It dictates how a specific building should be referred to in official records. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government, nor does it establish any advisory bodies or public comment periods.
qwen_block.s: Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the building referred to in section 1 shall be deemed to be a reference to the “James W. McCabe, Sr. Post Office Building”.

opus.w: This section only says that references in federal records to the building should be read as references to the "James W. McCabe, Sr. Post Office Building." No one outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision, and nothing here grants rulemaking authority, a hearing, consultation, or a right to sue. The word "regulation" only names a kind of record and does not give anyone authority to write rules.
